section_title: Penalties for illegal import, export, transport, manufacture, possession, etc. of intoxicating liquor
full_text: Whoever, in contravention of this Act or of any rule, notification or order made, issued or given, or of any licence or permit granted under this Act, imports, exports, transports, manufactures, collects or possesses any intoxicant shall, on conviction, be punished with imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than six months but which may extend up to five years and with fine.
explanation: Applies directly to unlawful possession, transport, collection, or illicit manufacture/distillation of ID liquor (Gudumba) or duty non-paid liquor in Andhra Pradesh.
essential_ingredients: Contravened the provisions of AP Excise Act or notifications
Act of importing, exporting, transporting, collecting, possessing, or manufacturing
Substance involved must be an intoxicant or intoxicating liquor / ID liquor
Absence of valid permit or excise licence
penalty_text: Rigorous imprisonment for 6 months to 5 years and fine.
source_gazette: Andhra Pradesh Gazette Act XVII of 1968

section_title: Illegal cultivation or possession of hemp plant or intoxicant materials
full_text: Whoever saves or cultivates any hemp plant or collects any portion of such plant from which an intoxicating drug can be manufactured, in contravention of this Act, shall be liable to punishment.
explanation: Applies to unlawful cultivation or collection of hemp/ganja or intoxicating plant components under state excise supervision.
essential_ingredients: Cultivation or collection of hemp plant or raw intoxicating plant material
Intent or knowledge regarding illicit production
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.
source_gazette: Andhra Pradesh Gazette Act XVII of 1968

section_title: Penalty for misconduct of licensee, etc.
full_text: Whoever, being the holder of a licence or permit granted under this Act, or being in the employ of such holder and acting on his behalf, fails to produce such licence or permit on demand or permits drunkenness or riotous conduct on premises shall be punishable.
explanation: Pertains to licensed retail wine/bar operators violating licence conditions or selling adulterated/unregistered liquor brands.
essential_ingredients: Accused is an excise licence/permit holder or employee acting on their behalf
Wilful breach of licence conditions or permit rules
Permitting riotous conduct, adulteration, or illegal timing of sales
penalty_text: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine up to Rs. 10,000.
source_gazette: Andhra Pradesh Gazette Act XVII of 1968

section_title: Penalty for adulteration resulting in grievous hurt or death
full_text: Whoever mixes or permits to be mixed with any liquor or intoxicant any noxious substance or substance likely to cause disability or death, and sells or distributes such adulterated liquor, shall, if death is caused thereby, be punished with imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment which shall not be less than ten years, and with fine.
explanation: Critical hooch tragedy section applied when spurious liquor contains methyl alcohol, chloral hydrate, or diazepam resulting in injury or death.
essential_ingredients: Adulteration of liquor with a noxious/poisonous substance (e.g. methanol)
Sale, distribution or transport of such contaminated liquor
Grievous hurt or fatality caused to consumers
penalty_text: Rigorous imprisonment for 10 years to Life imprisonment and heavy fine.

section_title: Liability of confiscation of vehicles, vessels, and receptacles
full_text: Whenever an offence has been committed which is punishable under this Act, anything used in the commission of such offence including vehicles, carts, vessels, packaging and receptacles shall be liable to confiscation by the authorized excise officer.
explanation: Enables statutory seizure and forfeiture proceedings for vehicles (cars, autos, lorries) transporting illicit or duty-evaded liquor.
essential_ingredients: Commission of an underlying offence under the AP Excise Act
Direct use of the vehicle/vessel/cart in the transport or concealment of the contraband
Seizure conducted by authorized excise officer
penalty_text: Statutory confiscation of conveyance and forfeiture to State Government.
source_gazette: Andhra Pradesh Gazette Act XVII of 1968
